form.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
form.label: GitHub Personal Access Token (for private repos)

command:
apt-get update >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git curl build-essential >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; cd /app; if [ ! -d /app/.venv ]; then python3 -m venv /app/.venv; /app/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; if [ -n "$GIT_REPOSITORY_URL" ]; then AUTH_REPO_URL="$GIT_REPOSITORY_URL"; if [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then AUTH_REPO_URL=$(echo "$GIT_REPOSITORY_URL" | sed -E "s#https://#https://${GITHUB_TOKEN}@#"); fi; if [ ! -d .git ]; then echo '[Runner] Clonando repositório Python...'; git clone --branch "$GIT_BRANCH" "$AUTH_REPO_URL" . ; else echo '[Runner] Atualizando repositório Python...'; git remote set-url origin "$AUTH_REPO_URL"; git fetch origin "$GIT_BRANCH"; git checkout "$GIT_BRANCH"; git pull origin "$GIT_BRANCH"; fi; else if [ ! -f main.py ] && [ ! -f app.py ]; then echo '[Runner] Criando aplicação Python demo...'; cat << 'EOF' > main.py
import http.server
import socketserver
import json
import os

PORT = int(os.environ.get('APP_PORT', 8000))

class Handler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-type', 'application/json')
        self.end_headers()
        response = {'status': 'online', 'runtime': 'Python 3.13', 'message': 'ServApp Python ativo no Cosmos-Server'}
        self.wfile.write(json.dumps(response).encode('utf-8'))

with socketserver.TCPServer(('', PORT), Handler) as httpd:
    print(f'Servidor Python ouvindo na porta {PORT}')
    httpd.serve_forever()
EOF
fi; fi; if [ -f requirements.txt ] && [ -n "$INSTALL_CMD" ]; then echo "[Runner] Executando: $INSTALL_CMD"; eval "$INSTALL_CMD"; fi; if [ -n "$BUILD_CMD" ]; then echo "[Runner] Executando: $BUILD_CMD"; eval "$BUILD_CMD"; fi; echo "[Runner] Iniciando serviço: $START_CMD"; exec /bin/sh -c "$START_CMD"
